results.description:
‘There’s just one other thing I need to ask you about, our Thursday night Slow Cooker Supper Club…’

When professional housesitter Erin moves into Marie’s cosy home at Station Cottages while the widow takes a four-month cruise, the job seems pretty easy:

1. Stay in the house to take care of Marie’s pup, Bella.

2. Keep an eye on Marie’s plantings in the community allotment.

3. Host the Thursday Night Slow Cooker Supper Club in Marie’s kitchen.

But sitting still isn’t easy for a woman who has spent her life running away, and with a distractingly gorgeous neighbour who seems to be keeping secrets of his own, Erin realises that her ‘easy’ gig is going to be anything but simple. In fact, it just might change her life…

Readers are loving The Slow Cooker Supper Club:

‘So warming and cosy and joyful and uplifting…It's got so much heart…I loved it' ★★★★★

'Will make you laugh, cry, rejoice…Wonderful…I loved every minute of it’ ★★★★★

‘Absolutely loved this…such a comforting and easy read. Loved it’ ★★★★★

‘A warm, comforting hug in book form…left me feeling completely cozy and satisfied from start to finish’ ★★★★★

‘This is one of those reads that snuggles and burrows into your heart…it’s one of those stories you want to dive in and live in yourself…I loved this book from start to finish’ ★★★★★

About the author

Sue Heath lives in Cheshire, England. When she isn’t working, she can often be found running around agility courses with her spaniel, and in the evenings, she loves to cook and spend time with family and friends.

‘The Secret Ingredient’ is an uplifting story that explores how a sense of community, sharing, friendship, love, and a feeling of belonging can help us make sense of life, find comfort, and heal. How we can find our happiness in ordinary things.

Sue has also written fourteen USA Today bestselling romcoms under the pseudonym Zara Stoneley and has sold over half a million copies of her stories worldwide.
